title: A New Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: "The moment you stepped out of the secret realm, the Voice of the Heavenly Dao rang in your ears: 'Interesting. You've finally started learning to play the game.'"

text.content: The traitor's lips curled into an eerie smile, a thorn piercing Chen Ji's heart. He had believed everything was under his control, yet the mockery blazing in that dying man's eyes clearly said—you missed a calculation. The bloody stench of the secret realm suddenly thickened. Chen Ji's fingertips trembled faintly as the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve grew searingly hot. Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted up: "Little Ji, during your divination just now, did you ever calculate that you yourself are merely a piece on someone else's chessboard?"
Chen Ji猛地抬头，只见那背叛者周身黑气翻涌，竟是魔道秘法——燃命之术！他早该料到，能潜入天青宗秘境之人，岂是泛泛之辈？"有意思。"陈机低笑出声，那笑意却不达眼底，"临死也要摆我一道，够狠。"他袖中天机录骤然绽放金光，第四页封印——崩裂。

Vast torrents of information flooded into his Mental Sea, and Chen Ji's entire body convulsed. The truth of the shackles— so this was it! His Chen family's generations of guardianship over the Tianji Record was not an honor, but a curse. The Heavenly Dao had imprisoned every prophet with shackles, and once they grew strong enough, it would harvest their Heavenly Fate Value. The reason he had been deemed "trash" was actually the result of the shackles' suppression! Now that the shackles had shattered, fifteen years of accumulated cultivation burst into his Dantian like a breached dam.

dialogue.content: "The shackles are broken; reaching Golden Core Peak is within reach." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted uncertainly. "But Little Ji, the chess player behind the shackles… do you truly wish to know?" Chen Ji's gaze turned icy cold: "Speak." Mo Xiansheng sighed. "The Eye of the Heavenly Dao. It has treated every prophet throughout history as chess pieces, and the Tianji Record is merely its eye planted in the mortal realm."

text.content: Chen Ji froze for an instant, then burst into cold laughter. "The Eye of the Heavenly Dao?" He savored the name. "Interesting. I'd like to see who plays black and who plays white in this game." True Yuan churned violently within him, and a Golden Core phantom gradually solidified at his Brow Center. Golden Core Peak! From Foundation Building to Golden Core Peak, ordinary cultivators might not reach it in an entire lifetime, yet he had done it in mere months. The cost — his Heavenly Fate Value plummeted by thirty points instantly.

choice.prompt: The Golden Core is formed, the truth of the shackles revealed. How will you respond now?

choices.text: Chase down and eliminate the remaining Demonic Path remnants
choices.description: Eradicate the roots completely, leave no future troubles. Strike first before the enemy can react.
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly cleanse the hidden dangers of the secret realm, eliminate three Demonic Path spies
choices.risk_hint: May expose your true combat power

text.content: Chen Ji flashed身形一闪，金丹真元化作剑芒横斩而出。三名魔道细作尚未反应过来，便已身首异处。鲜血溅落，陈机面无表情地收剑，"就这？"语气轻蔑至极。

dialogue.content: Ye Qing emerged from the shadows, the Demonic Path mist dissipating quietly. "Clean work. However… you've revealed yourself." Her gaze grew complicated. "The people of Tianqing Sect will soon know you're no ordinary man."

choices.text: Conceal your aura and present yourself as a废物
choices.description: Play dead to eat the tiger — let enemies continue to underestimate you, secretly arranging the board is the superior strategy.
choices.visible_cost: Must suppress three-tenths of your True Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the trash persona to buy time for future arrangements
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might see through your act

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息，金丹威压瞬间压回筑基中期。他踉跄几步，"咳……"吐出一口血沫，装作重伤垂死之态。夜清挑眉，"你倒是会演。"语气中竟有几分欣赏。

dialogue.content: "走吧，戏演够了。"夜清袖中魔气翻涌，将陈机周身气息彻底遮蔽，"圣宗那边传来消息——陈念就在北斗峰。"陈机眸光骤亮，旋即恢复平静，"……好。"

choices.text: Directly confront Mo Xiansheng for the complete truth
choices.description: No longer being led by the nose — to seize initiative, you must know everything.
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial intelligence, control more trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be holding something back

text.content: "先生，"陈机声音平静得可怕，"您还藏了多少？"墨先生残魂微微一顿，良久方道："小机子，你变聪明了。"语气中竟有几分欣慰，"……好，我告诉你。"他开始讲述陈家与天机录的真正渊源。

dialogue.content: "Chen Nian is indeed the lock and key, but she has another identity — she is the bridge between you and the Tianji Record. Without her, you can never truly merge with the Fifth Page." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. "So that's why the Heavenly Dao wants her?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent. "It's to ensure… you remain forever a chess piece."

text.content: At the secret realm's exit, Tianqing Sect disciples waited anxiously. Su Qingyao stood at the front of the crowd in azure robes, her brow furrowed tightly. "Why haven't they come out yet?" she murmured, her fingers unconsciously rubbing her sword hilt. Suddenly, the secret realm entrance blazed with brilliant light, and a figure stumbled out — Chen Ji. Covered in blood, pallid, looking utterly wretched. Sneers rippled through the crowd: "Look at that废物 — probably fled without even encountering a beast."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's eyes narrowed slightly. She had clearly sensed that faint, lingering… Golden Core aura on Chen Ji? Impossible. She stepped forward, her voice cold: "Chen Ji, are you injured?" Chen Ji grinned, revealing blood-stained teeth: "Don't worry, Senior Sister Su. Your junior brother has a tough life; he won't die." Yet that smile, in Su Qingyao's eyes, set every alarm bell ringing — this person was nowhere near as simple as he appeared.

text.content: After the crowd dispersed, Ye Qing materialized silently at Chen Ji's side. Demonic Path mist enveloped them both, blocking all detection. "Holy Sect forces are transporting Chen Nian; they'll pass through Sunset Canyon in three days." She handed over a Jade Slip. "This contains the route." Chen Ji took it, his divine sense probing within — route, guards, shift changes, everything was there. He looked up at Ye Qing: "Your terms?" Ye Qing smiled lightly, "You owe me a favor."

choice.prompt: The rescue operation in three days — how will you arrange it?

choices.text: Charge in alone and rescue with a single blade
choices.description: With Chen Ji's current Golden Core Peak combat power, a direct assault is entirely viable. Speed is paramount; more people only increase the risk of exposure.
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian and demonstrate absolute strength

text.content: Chen Ji crushed the Jade Slip, his voice cold: "Unnecessary. I'm enough alone." Ye Qing narrowed her eyes. "Confident." She didn't obstruct him, only adding meaningfully, "Sunset Canyon doesn't only have Holy Sect people." Chen Ji paused. "Who else?" Ye Qing smiled mysteriously and vanished into the mist.

dialogue.content: Meanwhile, deep within Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds. Ling Yuan sat枯坐于石台之上，浑浊的双眼骤然睁开，"有趣……枷锁竟碎了。"他苍老的面容上浮现一抹诡异的笑，"陈机，老夫倒要看看，你能走到哪一步。"指尖轻弹，一道传讯符破空而出。

choices.text: Form an alliance with Ye Qing and arrange things from the shadows
choices.description: Utilize Ye Qing's Demonic Path resources and intelligence network to weave a vast web beneath the Holy Sect's very nose, rescuing Chen Nian without a trace.
choices.visible_cost: Accumulate another debt to Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian covertly under the Holy Sect's nose, leaving no evidence
choices.risk_hint: Requires perfect coordination — any slip could be fatal

text.content: "Your favor, I'll remember it." Chen Ji tucked away the Jade Slip, his gaze deep. Ye Qing's lips curved slightly. "In three days, I'll have my people ambush the canyon's west side. You handle the frontal distraction while I extract Chen Nian." Chen Ji shook his head. "No — you have your people create a frontal feint. I'll go get her personally." Ye Qing愣了一下，旋即笑出声，"好，我倒小看你了。"
Night如墨，陈机独坐窗前，天机录残页在掌心缓缓浮现。枷锁已解，真相渐明，可他知道，这不过是更大棋局的开始。天道之眼……他倒要看看，这执棋者究竟是何方神圣。忽然，残页之上浮现一行金字——"陈念所在，北斗峰天枢阁。"陈机瞳孔骤缩，"这是……天机录的指引？"

choices.text: Spread false intelligence and employ feint tactics
choices.description: Use the intelligence network to spread news that Chen Nian is elsewhere, then secretly infiltrate the true location while the Holy Sect is distracted.
choices.visible_reward: Make the Holy Sect扑空，greatly boost morale
choices.risk_hint: Information leak may alert the enemy

text.content: Chen Ji连夜拜访天青宗情报据点，以"废柴师弟"的身份混入杂役之中。没人注意到他袖中滑出的传讯符，也没人知道他手指轻点间，数十条虚假情报已悄然散播出去。三日后，圣宗必会在错误的地点扑个空。

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of praise: "Feinting the east to strike the west — not bad. But Little Ji, are you certain this trick will work on the Holy Sect?" Chen Ji冷笑，"不需要骗过所有人，只需要让他们迟疑一刻钟。"墨先生沉默片刻，"……你比我想象的更像个棋手了。"

text.content: Three days passed in an instant. Sunset Canyon, the setting sun dyed the sky blood-red. Chen Ji clad in night attire, hidden in the cliff's shadow, looked down — twelve Holy Sect disciples escorted a prison cart slowly forward. Inside the cart, a slender figure curled up — his long-lost sister, Chen Nian. In five years she had grown from a naive girl into her current youthful form, her face full of defiance and unwillingness. "Nian'er…" Chen Ji clenched his fists until his knuckles went white.

dialogue.content: In the prison cart, Chen Nian seemed to sense something, her head snapping up. Her gaze pierced through the layers of guards, shooting straight toward a spot on the cliff wall — there was nothing there, yet she clearly felt… "Brother?" she whispered softly, her voice barely audible. The guard snapped impatiently: "Stay老实点！" Chen Nian smiled instead, that smile carrying tears of light. "He's here." The guard froze. "Who's here?" Chen Nian said nothing more, simply gazing quietly at the sky, her eyes brighter than they had ever been.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath. The Tianji Record Fragment hummed loudly in his Mental Sea. The next three hours unfolded like a flickering lantern — Holy Sect experts ambushing, Ling Yuan striking from the shadows, the Eye of the Heavenly Dao watching… he saw every branching possibility with perfect clarity. "Is it enough?" he asked himself. The answer was singular: "Yes." His body flashed, and he dove down like a hawk swooping on prey. Golden Core Peak pressure erupted outward, transforming into a dazzling sword light that slashed directly toward the prison cart!

"刺客！" Holy Sect disciples screamed in alarm, but had no time to react — wherever the sword light passed, bodies fell. Chen Ji单手掀开囚车笼门，一把抓住陈念的手腕，"走！" Chen Nian stumbled into his embrace, her thin shoulders trembling slightly. "哥……我就知道你会来。" Chen Ji throat tightened, yet his voice was deliberately light: "废话，你哥什么时候失约过？" He hoisted Chen Nian onto his back. Just as he was about to retreat, dozens of figures surged from the shadows on all sides — Holy Sect ambush troops, waiting all along.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, did you really think this old man didn't know your plans?" A hoary voice rang from the void. Ling Yuan materialized slowly, surrounded by Nascent Soul pressure. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply — Nascent Soul! The old fool had broken through! Ling Yuan stroked his beard and smiled, his clouded eyes full of scheming. "You thought the shackles breaking meant you could turn the tables? How laughable. A chess piece is always a chess piece — you'll never rise above." Chen Nian on his back softly asked: "Brother, what do we do?" Chen Ji laughed lowly, "Don't be afraid, Nian'er. Today your brother will teach certain people what it means to be one move behind."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan personally intervened to block you. The situation is critical. How will you break this deadlock?

choices.text: Burn Heavenly Fate Value and forcibly break through
choices.description: Facing a Nascent Soul with Golden Core is inherently unwinnable, but with the Tianji Record's foresight enhancement, there may still be a sliver of hope.
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian right under Ling Yuan's nose, dealing a crushing blow
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value will drop to dangerous levels

text.content: Chen Ji urgently activated the Tianji Record, golden light blazing to the heavens. His eyes in that moment transformed into two deep pools, reflecting countless possibilities of the future — every frame a path to survival, every path leading to the same destination. "Ling Yuan," his voice was calm, "you thought you were the hunter?" His fingertip flicked, and the Tianji Record Fragment flowed into his body. "You are merely an ant jumping about on my chessboard."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression shifted drastically. He clearly felt his fate's trajectory forcibly twisted by some unknown force! "Impossible!" he bellowed, Nascent Soul True Yuan erupting outward — yet the moment it touched Chen Ji's perimeter, it shattered violently. Chen Ji walked step by step toward the canyon exit with Chen Nian on his back. Behind him, Ling Yuan was nailed in place by an invisible force, unable to move. "Next time we meet, I'll let you die with understanding." Chen Ji walked away without looking back, his voice cold as frost.

choices.text: Have Ye Qing provide backup and divide the enemy's attention
choices.description: Let Ye Qing's Demonic Path forces create chaos while you slip away with Chen Nian, preserving your strength.
choices.visible_cost: Accumulate even more debt to Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate Value while successfully escaping
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji flicked his finger, and a secret transmission talisman shot into the sky. Almost simultaneously, an earth-shaking explosion erupted on the canyon's west flank — Demonic Path mist surged forth like a tide, scattering the Holy Sect disciples. "The Saint is here — who dares act so boldly!" Ye Qing's voice resounded across the night sky. Ling Yuan's face turned livid with fury: "Demonic path curs!" His attention was instantly drawn away.

Seizing the opening, Chen Ji sprinted through the chaos like a specter with Chen Nian on his back. "Brother, who's that old man?" Chen Nian asked from his back, her voice trembling. Chen Ji冷笑，"一个活够了的老东西。放心，哥记仇，等下次一并算清。" Before the words even faded, he had broken through the final blockade and vanished into the night. Behind him, Ling Yuan's roar echoed through the canyon — utterly futile.

choices.text: Confront Ling Yuan directly and expose his true colors
choices.description: Reveal Ling Yuan's conspiracy before the Holy Sect disciples, making him reap what he sows.
choices.visible_reward: Publicly humiliate Ling Yuan, becoming renowned across the world

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not flee. He turned, facing Ling Yuan, his lips curling into a mocking arc. "Elder Ling, have you forgotten something?" He drew a Projection Stone from his chest. "I've been holding onto evidence of your secret dealings with the Holy Sect all along." The images shown in the Projection Stone made everyone's expression change drastically — Ling Yuan in secret talks with a Holy Sect Elder, scheming to divide the Tianji Record!

text.content: In a safe zone, Chen Ji set Chen Nian down. The siblings sat facing each other. Moonlight fell upon Chen Nian's gaunt face, filling Chen Ji with mixed emotions. "Nian'er, these five years… you've had it hard." Chen Nian shook her head, yet tears streamed down uncontrollably. "I'm not suffering. Brother, I've been waiting for you all along." She grasped Chen Ji's hand; a faint warmth radiated from her palm — that was the unique aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. "Brother, I can sense it… the Tianji Record is with you, right?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji沉默片刻，轻轻点头。陈念破涕为笑，那笑容明媚得让人心碎，"我就知道。爹娘说得对，我们陈家……是守护天机录的人。"她将额头抵在陈机胸口，"哥，我虽然不懂那些大道理，但我知道，你在做正确的事。" Chen Ji throat choked up, yet he forced out a joking remark: "傻丫头，你哥我可从来不是什么好人。" Chen Nian噗嗤笑出声，"骗子。你要是坏人，就不会冒着生命危险来救我了。"

text.content: It was deep night. Chen Ji let Chen Nian sleep first, but he himself had no sleepiness. He walked to the cave mouth, gazing up at the star-filled sky. The Tianji Record Fragment rotated slowly in his Mental Sea; the Fourth Page's contents had fully unsealed — the truth of the shackles, the fate of prophets through the ages, the existence of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao… all the fragments were assembling into a complete picture. "Mo Xiansheng," he silently called in his heart, "this game, I've taken it on." From the depths of his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted up: "Little Ji, are you certain you wish to play against Heaven?" Chen Ji冷笑，"不是我要与天博弈，是天不许我做棋子。既如此，我便掀了这棋盘。"

In the final moment before dawn, Chen Ji hoisted the sleeping Chen Nian onto his back and set out on the journey home. The secret realm's exit was just ahead; the first light of dawn pierced the clouds and scattered across the earth. The instant he stepped
